content:
Chat App context:
- The chat app UI is primarily implemented in AIChatApp.Web/Components/Pages/Home.razor.
- Home.razor manages conversations, side navigation, composer, message rendering, message actions, reporting, account modals, 2FA setup modal, FAQ modal, and responsive drawer behavior.
- Chat requests go to AIChatApp.API/Controllers/ChatController.cs.
- Streaming chat uses ChatOrchestrator.StreamAsync in AIChatApp.API/Services/Orchestration/ChatOrchestrator.cs.
- Conversation messages are saved through ChatHistoryService.
- The chat app should answer project documentation questions using exact quick answers first, then safe matching, then normal LLM generation with retrieved context.
- Chat history is not cached. Browser-side FAQ cache was removed; profile/avatar display state may still use per-user local storage.
